source_reference.description: The frozen Group-2 audit records the source paper as reporting nearly 80% distinct-pattern reduction.

rules: No candidate poisoning sequence is generated.
No CQL, DT, MTM, or other learner is trained or evaluated.
The clean dataset, clustering semantics, feature preprocessing, and k remain frozen.
The only swept variable is actual fixed-length decision-unit window length.
All integer actual window lengths from 2 through 10 are reported; no length may be omitted after seeing the results.
The source's nearly-80-percent value is a descriptive reference only, not a gate.
The length numerically closest to the source reference may be reported descriptively but must not be promoted to a new attack configuration.
The endpoint-span notation l = L - 1 is reported only as a notation view; it is not asserted to be the source authors' intended implementation.
Canonical Gate B and the frozen Group-2 conclusion remain unchanged.
